com.vector.cfg.model.sysdesc.api.eoc

Interface IExecutionOrderConstraint

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IHasModelObject, IIdentifiable, IModelAbstraction

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IExecutionOrderConstraint
extends IIdentifiable
    An ExecutionOrderConstraint restricts the execution order of a set of ExecutableEntities. Therefore successor and direct successor relationships can be defined for executable entities (functions), but also for events (triggers).
